name: Primary-source and retained-material access
description: Retrieve identified publications and advertised supplements, expose exact source windows, and extract selected tables or images while preserving source identity and inspection scope.

outputs.records: source IDs, titles, metadata and continuation; no scientific conclusion

capability_operations.invocation_note: Normalized capability contract; the confirmed callable list identifies existing related primitives only, not interchangeable signatures.

capability_operations.operation: Acquire a selected article or advertised supplement

inputs.version_or_asset_ref: identifier returned by the corresponding listing

outputs.source: retained original bytes, representation identity and digest
outputs.projection: ordered article text where available; may omit XML tables

capability_operations.invocation_note: Normalized capability contract; the confirmed callable list identifies existing related primitives only, not interchangeable signatures.

inputs.selection: UTF-8 byte window, physical PDF page, image frame, archive member, or XLSX sheet and row window

outputs.material: exact selected text, pixels, rows or member bytes
outputs.provenance: original coordinates and representation-specific identity; formulas and cached values distinguished

capability_operations.invocation_note: Normalized capability contract; the confirmed callable list identifies existing related primitives only, not interchangeable signatures.

research_operations_performed: All 142 case groups have an explicit source-inspection scope in case_records.json; 134 relevant-primary-section groups and 8 abstract/summary groups. Specific JSON/XML/PDF/XLSX reads are retained in the corpus; they were not all calls through the repository registry.
capability_specifications_not_confirmed_: A dedicated source-local scientific passage-ranking tool and dedicated XML-table API were not found in the inspected catalog; existing source windows remain available.
author_experiments_are_source_evidence_o: All reported biological experiments remain author work; downloading and viewing their records does not repeat them.
availability.binding_limit: A repository catalog definition is confirmed source-code identity, not proof of caller enablement, service availability, installed dependencies or execution in this research. Research scripts are retained operations, not registered runtime tools.

limits: An access failure or projection omission is not biological absence.
A publication, its XML, PDF and supplement can represent the same observation; access does not create independent evidence.
PDF extraction has no confirmed OCR in the inspected manual; viewing pixels is separate from rendering.
